2026-11-09-baabe-leo-milei-dimuqraadiyad.summary: In his first speech in Buenos Aires, Pope Leo XIV called on President Javier Milei and Argentina's politicians to safeguard democracy and to use their words carefully.

2026-11-09-trump-dana-white-afhayeenka-a.summary: President Donald Trump said on Truth Social on Saturday that he had offered the job of White House press secretary to Dana White, head of the UFC, Al Jazeera reported; White is expected to meet Trump on Monday to discuss it.
2026-11-09-trump-dana-white-afhayeenka-a.imageAlt: Dana White, head of the UFC

2026-11-08-araghchi-dhexdhexaadiyayaasha.title: Araghchi: Mediators on Iran-US peace deal have stopped travelling

He said it would take time before the atmosphere is right for the trips to resume.
2026-11-08-araghchi-dhexdhexaadiyayaasha.imageAlt: Abbas Araghchi meeting Rafael Grossi, director of the IAEA, in Vienna

2026-11-08-leeds-cambaareysay-cunsuriyad.title: Leeds United condemn online racist abuse aimed at Jayden Bogle
2026-11-08-leeds-cambaareysay-cunsuriyad.summary: Leeds United have condemned "disgusting" online racist abuse directed at defender Jayden Bogle after Saturday's 1-0 win over Tottenham. Bogle was accused over a tackle on Mathys Tel that the referee did not punish after a VAR review, and Tottenham said they will submit a formal complaint.
2026-11-08-leeds-cambaareysay-cunsuriyad.imageAlt: Elland Road, the stadium of Leeds United, in the city of Leeds

2026-11-08-soomaaliya-liibiya-kulan-wasi.title: Somalia and Libya hold talks on strengthening economic and financial cooperation
2026-11-08-soomaaliya-liibiya-kulan-wasi.summary: Somalia's Foreign Minister Abdisalam Ali met Libya's Finance Minister Rashid Abu Qaffah in Tripoli, where they discussed strengthening economic and financial cooperation and increasing Somalia's live-animal exports.
2026-11-08-soomaaliya-liibiya-kulan-wasi.imageAlt: Somali Foreign Minister Abdisalam Ali and Libyan Finance Minister Rashid Abu Qaffah shaking hands in Tripoli

2026-11-08-trump-iran-weerar-cusub-uusan.title: Trump: Renewed attacks on Iran "highly unlikely" if talks make progress
2026-11-08-trump-iran-weerar-cusub-uusan.summary: US President Donald Trump said in a phone interview with CNN on Sunday that it is "highly unlikely" the US will return to war with Iran as long as there is progress in talks on its nuclear programme and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. He said it depends on whether Iran signs "a very strong agreement".
2026-11-08-trump-iran-weerar-cusub-uusan.imageAlt: US President Donald Trump giving an interview, photo from 2025

2026-11-08-pibor-splm-doorashada-hordhac.title: South Sudan: Dispute over SPLM primaries in Greater Pibor
2026-11-08-pibor-splm-doorashada-hordhac.summary: A group of delegates from the ruling SPLM party has accused the committee running the primaries in the Greater Pibor administration of bias and of backing a particular candidate. The process, which had been running for nearly 2 weeks, was suspended on Friday, with officials citing "technical challenges".
2026-11-08-pibor-splm-doorashada-hordhac.imageAlt: A view of Pibor, South Sudan

2026-11-08-erdogan-aliyev-karabakh-maali.title: Erdoğan joins Aliyev for Azerbaijan's Victory Day commemorations in Karabakh
2026-11-08-erdogan-aliyev-karabakh-maali.summary: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan attended Azerbaijan's 6th Victory Day commemorations in Karabakh on Sunday at the invitation of President Ilham Aliyev. At a joint press conference, Aliyev said the unity of the two countries "will last forever".
2026-11-08-erdogan-aliyev-karabakh-maali.imageAlt: Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev, photo from 2025

2026-11-08-ruushka-weerar-koronto-maraak.title: Russia says it hit power substations and 3 Ukraine-bound ships; hundreds of thousands without power
2026-11-08-ruushka-weerar-koronto-maraak.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry said overnight strikes hit 3 cargo ships it accused of carrying weapons for Ukraine and 2 electricity substations. France 24 said hundreds of thousands of Ukrainians were left without power on Sunday after Russian strikes on energy infrastructure.

2026-11-08-tromso-taageerayaal-dhaawac-g.title: Norway: Fans injured after part of the stand gives way at Tromsø stadium
2026-11-08-tromso-taageerayaal-dhaawac-g.summary: Several fans were injured, one of whom was taken to hospital, after part of the away section at Tromsø's stadium gave way during Sunday's match against Bodø/Glimt, both clubs said. The match was stopped shortly before half-time.

2026-11-08-masar-tareenada-4-dhimasho-88.title: Egypt: Death toll from Giza train collision rises to 4, with 88 injured
2026-11-08-masar-tareenada-4-dhimasho-88.summary: Egypt's health ministry said at least 4 people were killed and nearly 90 injured when two trains collided in Giza province near Cairo. Earlier reports had put the number of injured at 64 with no confirmed deaths.
2026-11-08-masar-tareenada-4-dhimasho-88.imageAlt: A train of the Egyptian National Railways (ENR)

2026-11-08-amsterdam-socod-gaza-israaiil.title: Amsterdam: Tens of thousands march to demand Dutch government action against Israel
2026-11-08-amsterdam-socod-gaza-israaiil.summary: Tens of thousands of people, many dressed in red, marched through Amsterdam on Sunday, pressing the Dutch government to take tougher action against Israel over Gaza.
2026-11-08-amsterdam-socod-gaza-israaiil.imageAlt: Dam Square in central Amsterdam, with the Royal Palace and the Nieuwe Kerk

2026-11-08-juba-dib-u-eegis-amniga-suuqy.title: Juba: City authorities review security operations in neighbourhoods and markets
2026-11-08-juba-dib-u-eegis-amniga-suuqy.summary: Juba city authorities are reviewing security operations in neighbourhoods and markets, focusing on young people engaged in unlicensed brokering and on improving general order.
2026-11-08-juba-dib-u-eegis-amniga-suuqy.imageAlt: A market in Juba, the capital of South Sudan

2026-11-08-guehi-baaritaan-dhaawac-engla.title: England await results of Marc Guehi injury scan ahead of Nations League matches
2026-11-08-guehi-baaritaan-dhaawac-engla.summary: Manchester City defender Marc Guehi will have a scan on a hip complaint on Sunday to determine whether he can join up with England this week. The 26-year-old was substituted at half-time of City's defeat by Nottingham Forest on Saturday.
2026-11-08-guehi-baaritaan-dhaawac-engla.imageAlt: Marc Guehi in England's match against Panama at the 2026 World Cup

2026-11-08-krakow-baaritaan-argagixiso-b.title: Poland: Terror investigation opened into Krakow shooting, two days of national mourning declared
2026-11-08-krakow-baaritaan-argagixiso-b.summary: Poland on Sunday opened a terrorism investigation into Saturday's shooting on Krakow's Main Square in which 6 people were killed, and declared two days of national mourning. Authorities said the 24-year-old suspect was fascinated by far-right ideologies.
2026-11-08-krakow-baaritaan-argagixiso-b.imageAlt: The Pod Złotą Głową building on the Main Market Square in Kraków's Old Town

2026-11-08-abu-dhabi-wadahadal-ukraine-y.title: France: Europe will take part in US-mediated Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
2026-11-08-abu-dhabi-wadahadal-ukraine-y.summary: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said on Sunday that Europeans will be represented, and France will take part, in the US-mediated Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday and Wednesday.
2026-11-08-abu-dhabi-wadahadal-ukraine-y.imageAlt: Jean-Noël Barrot, French Minister of Foreign Affairs

2026-11-08-baabe-leo-ixtiraam-haweenka-l.title: Pope Leo XIV urges men to respect their wives amid femicide crisis in Latin America
2026-11-08-baabe-leo-ixtiraam-haweenka-l.summary: Pope Leo XIV on Sunday urged men to treat their wives with respect as he wrapped up the first leg of his 12-day tour of Latin America. The region has recorded nearly 20,000 women killed because of their gender over the past five years.
2026-11-08-baabe-leo-ixtiraam-haweenka-l.imageAlt: Pope Leo XIV on the balcony of Saint Peter's Basilica after his election in 2025

2026-11-08-masar-tareen-isku-dhac-al-ayy.title: Egypt: 64 injured in train crash south of Cairo
2026-11-08-masar-tareen-isku-dhac-al-ayy.summary: Two trains collided on Sunday in the al-Ayyat district of Giza province, south of Cairo, injuring 64 people, according to Egypt's Ministry of Health. The Egyptian Railway Authority said emergency teams and cranes were sent to clear the wreckage.
2026-11-08-masar-tareen-isku-dhac-al-ayy.imageAlt: A train of the Egyptian National Railways (ENR) at Alexandria station

2026-11-08-koonfur-suudaan-wadahadalka-x.title: South Sudan: Political parties' election dialogue to resume on Monday to adopt resolutions
2026-11-08-koonfur-suudaan-wadahadalka-x.summary: Leaders of South Sudan's political parties have agreed to reconvene in Juba on Monday, 9 November, to finalise and adopt the resolutions of the election dialogue ahead of the general elections in December 2026, the office of the SPLM Secretary General said. The date of the closing ceremony will be set in consultation with President Salva Kiir.
2026-11-08-koonfur-suudaan-wadahadalka-x.imageAlt: Dr Akol Paul Kordit, Secretary General of South Sudan's SPLM party

2026-11-08-messi-mls-golden-boot-labo-xi.title: Lionel Messi becomes first player to win the MLS Golden Boot in two consecutive seasons
2026-11-08-messi-mls-golden-boot-labo-xi.summary: Inter Miami's Lionel Messi scored 26 goals in 31 games, becoming the first player in MLS history to win the Golden Boot in consecutive seasons. The 39-year-old Messi also provided 17 assists.
2026-11-08-messi-mls-golden-boot-labo-xi.imageAlt: Lionel Messi playing for Inter Miami (2025)

2026-11-08-museveni-maalgashadayaasha-ta.title: Museveni urges Italian investors to invest in industrialisation in Uganda
2026-11-08-museveni-maalgashadayaasha-ta.summary: Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni met a delegation of more than 80 people from Italy in Entebbe and urged them to invest in coffee and lithium battery industries. Prime Minister Robinah Nabbanja said Italy has allocated 120 million euros to Uganda's coffee sector, and a development cooperation agreement was signed at the meeting.

2026-11-08-mareykanka-iron-gate-iiraan.title: US forms task force to block Iran's land supply routes
2026-11-08-mareykanka-iron-gate-iiraan.summary: US Central Command (CENTCOM) said it has created a new task force, Task Force Iron Gate, aimed at stopping weapons and sanctioned goods moving across Iran's land borders and the Caspian Sea. CENTCOM also said 147 commercial vessels have been redirected since July, while Iranian media reported explosions on Qeshm island and in coastal towns.
2026-11-08-mareykanka-iron-gate-iiraan.imageAlt: The Strait of Hormuz seen from near Bandar Abbas, Iran

2026-11-08-el-hierro-xaalad-degdeg-muhaa.title: Canary island of El Hierro declares emergency after rise in migrant arrivals
2026-11-08-el-hierro-xaalad-degdeg-muhaa.summary: Authorities on the Spanish island of El Hierro declared an emergency and asked the government in Madrid for help after more than 3,300 migrants arrived on about 30 boats since the start of November, local officials said. The island has about 11,400 residents.
2026-11-08-el-hierro-xaalad-degdeg-muhaa.imageAlt: The coastal village of La Restinga, on the island of El Hierro

2026-11-08-valencia-real-madrid-0-3-mest.title: La Liga: Real Madrid beat Valencia 3-0 at the Mestalla
2026-11-08-valencia-real-madrid-0-3-mest.summary: Real Madrid beat Valencia 3-0 at the Mestalla on Saturday, with goals from Federico Valverde, Arda Güler and Kylian Mbappé, Yahoo Sports reported, a result also confirmed by VAVEL. The win, their eighth in a row, put Real Madrid level on points with La Liga leaders Barcelona.

2026-11-07-herzog-eisenkot-dowlad-dhisid.title: Israel's president picks Gadi Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form the next government
2026-11-07-herzog-eisenkot-dowlad-dhisid.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has tasked Gadi Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party, with forming the next government after 67 lawmakers backed him while Netanyahu received 46. Eisenkot has 28 days, extendable by 14 days, to secure at least 61 of the Knesset's 120 seats.
2026-11-07-herzog-eisenkot-dowlad-dhisid.imageAlt: Gadi Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party

2026-11-07-faransiiska-dibadbax-qiimaha-.title: France: more than 140,000 people protest against the rising cost of living
2026-11-07-faransiiska-dibadbax-qiimaha-.summary: France's Interior Ministry said about 146,000 people, 46,000 of them in Paris, protested nationwide on Saturday against the rising cost of living, while unions put the figure at 250,000. Police used tear gas in Paris and Lyon, in the fourth consecutive weekend of protests.
2026-11-07-faransiiska-dibadbax-qiimaha-.imageAlt: An earlier demonstration in the streets of Paris (2023)

2026-11-07-alcaraz-ruud-finalka-paris-sh.title: Tennis: Carlos Alcaraz beats Casper Ruud, will face Ben Shelton in the Paris Masters final
2026-11-07-alcaraz-ruud-finalka-paris-sh.summary: Carlos Alcaraz beat Casper Ruud 6-4, 6-4 in the Paris Masters semi-finals, while Ben Shelton beat Luca Van Assche 5-7, 6-3, 6-4, ESPN reported, results also confirmed by the ATP Tour. Alcaraz said he wants revenge against Shelton after losing their last meeting at the US Open.
2026-11-07-alcaraz-ruud-finalka-paris-sh.imageAlt: Carlos Alcaraz playing at Roland Garros 2025

2026-11-08-mareykanka-abaal-marin-macluu.title: US offers a reward of up to $20 million for information on Iran's nuclear programme
2026-11-08-mareykanka-abaal-marin-macluu.summary: The US State Department's Rewards for Justice programme announced a reward of up to $20 million, and possible relocation, for anyone providing information about Iran's nuclear programme. Iran insists its programme is peaceful and that it does not seek a nuclear weapon.
2026-11-08-mareykanka-abaal-marin-macluu.imageAlt: The US State Department building in Washington

2026-11-07-baabe-leo-uruguay-cibaado.title: Pope Leo XIV holds his first mass in Uruguay during Latin America tour
2026-11-07-baabe-leo-uruguay-cibaado.summary: Pope Leo XIV celebrated mass on Saturday in the city of Paysandu in western Uruguay, attended by about 40,000 people according to the Vatican, as part of a 12-day tour of Latin America. The visit comes after lung surgery last month, and he travels to Argentina on Sunday.

2026-11-08-arsenal-hull-1-0-odegaard.title: Arsenal beat Hull City 1-0 with a late goal from Martin Ødegaard
2026-11-08-arsenal-hull-1-0-odegaard.summary: Arsenal beat Hull City 1-0 in the Premier League at the Emirates Stadium on Saturday, with captain Martin Ødegaard scoring in the 72nd minute after following up a shot from Noni Madueke.

2026-11-08-all-blacks-scotland-43-21-mur.title: All Blacks beat Scotland 43-21 at Murrayfield
2026-11-08-all-blacks-scotland-43-21-mur.summary: New Zealand's rugby team beat Scotland 43-21 in Edinburgh on Saturday in the Nations Championship, scoring seven tries to Scotland's three, BBC Sport and the official All Blacks website reported. Scotland, only three points behind at half-time, failed to score in the second half.

2026-11-08-poland-rasaas-krakow-fagaarah.title: Poland: At least 6 people killed in a shooting on Krakow's main market square
2026-11-08-poland-rasaas-krakow-fagaarah.summary: Krakow police said an armed man driving a car opened fire on Saturday on people in the city's main market square, killing at least 6 people and wounding 15 others. Police said the suspect was shot and injured and taken to hospital.
2026-11-08-poland-rasaas-krakow-fagaarah.imageAlt: Krakow's Main Market Square (Rynek Główny) and St. Mary's Basilica

2026-11-08-f1-hamilton-verstappen-gadaas.title: F1: Hamilton and Verstappen to start from the back at the São Paulo Grand Prix
2026-11-08-f1-hamilton-verstappen-gadaas.summary: Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) and Max Verstappen (Red Bull) will start Sunday's São Paulo Grand Prix from the back of the grid after their cars were fitted with complete new power units. Charles Leclerc received a 10-place penalty and George Russell 5 places.
2026-11-08-f1-hamilton-verstappen-gadaas.imageAlt: The start-finish straight at the Interlagos circuit in São Paulo, Brazil

2026-11-08-new-zealand-doorasho-guuleyst.title: New Zealand election produces no clear winner after a very tight result
2026-11-08-new-zealand-doorasho-guuleyst.summary: Preliminary results from Saturday's election show Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's National Party won 42 seats, 19 short of the number needed, while Chris Hipkins' Labour Party won 36. Both sides are preparing for coalition talks that could take weeks.
2026-11-08-new-zealand-doorasho-guuleyst.imageAlt: New Zealand's parliament buildings in Wellington

2026-11-08-trump-stephen-miller-madaxa-s.title: Trump names Stephen Miller White House chief of staff
2026-11-08-trump-stephen-miller-madaxa-s.summary: President Donald Trump has named Stephen Miller, the deputy chief of staff and architect of his tough immigration policy, to replace Susie Wiles, after the Republican Party's historic losses in the midterm elections.
2026-11-08-trump-stephen-miller-madaxa-s.imageAlt: Stephen Miller aboard Air Force One, 2017

2026-11-08-kenya-wax-soo-saarka-sonkorta.title: Kenya: Sugar production up 56.7% as prices fall
2026-11-08-kenya-wax-soo-saarka-sonkorta.summary: Data from the Kenya Sugar Board show that local factories produced 690,521 tonnes of sugar between January and September 2026, compared with 440,652 tonnes in the same period last year. The average retail price fell to Sh155 per kilo in September 2026, from Sh171 in September 2025.
2026-11-08-kenya-wax-soo-saarka-sonkorta.imageAlt: A tractor hauling sugarcane in Migori, Kenya

2026-11-08-ingiriiska-digniin-safarka-mo.title: UK warns its citizens against travel to Moyale after violence on the Ethiopian border
2026-11-08-ingiriiska-digniin-safarka-mo.summary: The UK Foreign Office (FCDO) on 6 November advised its citizens against all but essential travel to the town of Moyale and the 5 kilometres around it on the Kenya-Ethiopia border, citing violence in Ethiopia that has affected the Kenyan side. Kenya's Inspector General of Police Douglas Kanja made a security visit to Moyale on 5 November and said Kenya had contacted Ethiopia to bring the conflict to an end.
2026-11-08-ingiriiska-digniin-safarka-mo.imageAlt: The road to Moyale on the Kenya-Ethiopia border

2026-11-08-wau-xafiisyada-shirkadaha-diy.title: Wau: State authorities close the offices of two airlines over a $5 tax dispute
2026-11-08-wau-xafiisyada-shirkadaha-diy.summary: The authorities of South Sudan's Western Bahr el Ghazal state have closed the offices of Kush Airlines and Arojet Airlines in the town of Wau after they refused to collect a 5-dollar ticket tax from passengers. State officials said the tax is lawful and is paid by passengers, not by the airlines.
2026-11-08-wau-xafiisyada-shirkadaha-diy.imageAlt: A cargo plane landing at Wau airport, South Sudan

2026-11-08-kenya-mariga-laga-saaray-fkf.title: Kenya: McDonald Mariga removed as FKF vice-president
2026-11-08-kenya-mariga-laga-saaray-fkf.summary: At a special general meeting of the Football Kenya Federation (FKF) in Meru on Saturday, 65 delegates voted to remove vice-president McDonald Mariga, the former Inter Milan star, and 6 other members of the National Executive Committee. AFC Leopards chairman Boniface Ambani was the only one to oppose it.

2026-11-08-kenya-mackenzie-200-sano-shak.title: Kenya: Paul Mackenzie sentenced to 200 years in prison over the Shakahola killings
2026-11-08-kenya-mackenzie-200-sano-shak.summary: A court in Kenya on Friday sentenced cult leader Paul Mackenzie to 200 years in prison after he was found guilty over the deaths of 190 children who were starved and killed in the Shakahola forest. Justice Diana Kavedza said the sentence consists of 100 years for killing by starvation and 100 years for direct killing.
2026-11-08-kenya-mackenzie-200-sano-shak.imageAlt: The Galana River near Shakahola, Kilifi county, Kenya

2026-11-08-tanzania-sgr-tabora-kigoma-ma.title: Tanzania secures $1.2 billion to build the Tabora–Kigoma section of the SGR railway
2026-11-08-tanzania-sgr-tabora-kigoma-ma.summary: Tanzania has secured financing of 1.2 billion dollars arranged by the African Development Bank (AfDB) to build the 411-kilometre Tabora–Kigoma section of the SGR railway. The agreement, which involves 9 banks, is part of a 2.3 billion dollar financing package and includes an 800 million dollar guarantee provided by the AfDB.
2026-11-08-tanzania-sgr-tabora-kigoma-ma.imageAlt: Passengers leaving an SGR train in Tanzania

2026-11-07-khawaja-sandpapergate-kooxda-.title: Cricket: Usman Khawaja says the whole Australia team knew about the 2018 ball-tampering scandal
2026-11-07-khawaja-sandpapergate-kooxda-.summary: Former Australia player Usman Khawaja told The Sydney Morning Herald that the whole squad knew about the 2018 ball-tampering plan known as 'Sandpapergate'. Cricket Australia said it remains comfortable with the findings of its original investigation but will consider any new evidence.

2026-11-06-soomaaliya-oo-wajahaysa-isgoy.title: Somalia at a dangerous crossroads: will it learn the lessons of Libya and Sudan?
2026-11-06-soomaaliya-oo-wajahaysa-isgoy.summary: Somalia's political disputes, particularly over the Constitution, elections and the struggle for power, could endanger the country's stability. There are fears that foreign countries could exploit internal divisions, as happened in Libya and Sudan. Somalis are urged to resolve their political differences and to prevent civil war and foreign interference that could endanger the country's future.
2026-11-06-soomaaliya-oo-wajahaysa-isgoy.imageAlt: A man in a blue suit and glasses, official photo.

2026-11-06-crystal-palace-hoffenheim-eur.title: Europa League: Kamada's late goal earns Crystal Palace a 1-1 draw with Hoffenheim
2026-11-06-crystal-palace-hoffenheim-eur.summary: Crystal Palace drew 1-1 with Hoffenheim after Daichi Kamada scored in the 90+1st minute, with Alexander Prass having given Hoffenheim the lead in the 7th minute, Bundesliga.com reported. In Thursday's other games, Milan lost 0-2 at home to Ferencváros, while Bournemouth won 1-3 at Sparta Praha, according to UEFA's results list.

2026-11-06-isbahaysiga-sacuudiga-gantaal.title: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted a missile fired towards the Medina region
2026-11-06-isbahaysiga-sacuudiga-gantaal.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile fired by Yemen's Houthis towards the Medina region, after the civil defence agency warned of danger near the port of Yanbu. The Houthis denied targeting the city, calling the accusation a fabrication.
2026-11-06-isbahaysiga-sacuudiga-gantaal.imageAlt: General view of the city of Medina in Saudi Arabia

2026-11-06-george-russell-isqiimeyn-xill.title: George Russell vows a deep look in the mirror after a disappointing season
2026-11-06-george-russell-isqiimeyn-xill.summary: Mercedes driver George Russell said he will take a deep look at himself to work out how he can improve after a 2026 season he called disappointing. Russell has won only 3 races, while his teammate Kimi Antonelli has won 9 on his way to becoming the youngest champion in Formula 1 history.
2026-11-06-george-russell-isqiimeyn-xill.imageAlt: Mercedes driver George Russell at the 2025 Italian Grand Prix

2026-11-06-california-newsom-xukunnada-d.title: California Governor Newsom commutes death sentences of 548 prisoners to life in prison
2026-11-06-california-newsom-xukunnada-d.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 people on death row in the state to life in prison. The decision is seen as largely symbolic, as California has not executed anyone since 2006, and it comes as Newsom is discussed as a possible candidate.

2026-11-06-iiraan-tankiyada-hormuz-dab.title: Iran says several oil tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz
2026-11-06-iiraan-tankiyada-hormuz-dab.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said at least 5 oil tankers and a tugboat caught fire in separate incidents in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran said one of the vessels struck a mine, as the US and Israeli war on Iran remains unresolved.
2026-11-06-iiraan-tankiyada-hormuz-dab.imageAlt: Photo taken from space showing the Strait of Hormuz

2026-11-06-eritrea-isaias-ergayga-shiina.title: Eritrea: President Isaias Afwerki meets China's special envoy for the Horn of Africa
2026-11-06-eritrea-isaias-ergayga-shiina.summary: President Isaias Afwerki met Hu Changchun, China's Special Envoy for Horn of Africa Affairs, in Asmara on 5 November, and they discussed bilateral ties and the situation in the region, Eritrea's Ministry of Information said. Hu reiterated China's position that Eritrea's sovereignty and territorial integrity must be respected.

2026-11-06-uganda-bacrimin-bilaash-beera.title: Uganda prepares to distribute free fertiliser to smallholder coffee farmers
2026-11-06-uganda-bacrimin-bilaash-beera.summary: Uganda's government is preparing to distribute free fertiliser to smallholder coffee farmers in selected districts to raise production. The paper said more than 27 truckloads of fertiliser have been offloaded in Entebbe, and that Intracom Fertilizers has been contracted to supply organic fertiliser for coffee, cocoa and tea.

2026-11-06-suuqyada-mareykanka-saamiyada.title: Tech and AI shares fall after the US election
2026-11-06-suuqyada-mareykanka-saamiyada.summary: US stock markets fell on Thursday, with the Nasdaq down 4.8 percent, the S&P 500 down 3.6 percent and the Dow Jones down 2.8 percent by midday. The BBC said SpaceX shares fell more than 9 percent and Tesla more than 11 percent, as investors worry about possible curbs on data centres and the AI industry.
2026-11-06-suuqyada-mareykanka-saamiyada.imageAlt: The New York Stock Exchange building on Wall Street

2026-11-06-paraguay-madaxweyne-pena-isca.title: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña resigns after the collapse of ueno bank
2026-11-06-paraguay-madaxweyne-pena-isca.summary: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña resigned on Thursday after the collapse of digital lender ueno left millions of customers unable to access their accounts and the opposition began impeachment proceedings. Peña said he took the decision for the country's stability and to preserve democratic institutions, while Vice President Pedro Alliana is expected to take over.

2026-11-06-itoobiya-shiinaha-deeq-tareen.title: Ethiopia and China sign $15 million grant for the Ethiopia–Djibouti railway
2026-11-06-itoobiya-shiinaha-deeq-tareen.summary: The governments of Ethiopia and China have signed a $15 million grant agreement in Addis Ababa to strengthen the operation and maintenance of the Ethiopia–Djibouti railway. It was signed by State Minister of Finance Tiguist Fisseha and Liu Xiaoguang of the Chinese embassy, and covers spare parts for electric locomotives and technical training.
2026-11-06-itoobiya-shiinaha-deeq-tareen.imageAlt: A train of Ethiopian Railways on the line

2026-11-06-kenya-maxkamad-hakisay-shaqaa.title: Kenya: Malindi court suspends recruitment of IEBC chief executive
2026-11-06-kenya-maxkamad-hakisay-shaqaa.summary: The Employment and Labour Relations Court in Malindi has temporarily suspended the recruitment of the Secretary and Chief Executive Officer of the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC), halting interviews scheduled for 12 and 13 November. The order by Justice J.N. Abuodha stems from a petition filed by Thomas Kennedy Balala and will remain in force until the inter partes hearing on 17 November.
2026-11-06-kenya-maxkamad-hakisay-shaqaa.imageAlt: Logo of Kenya's Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC)

2026-11-06-kozo-tashima-doorashada-fifa.title: Japanese football official Kozo Tashima to stand against Infantino for FIFA president
2026-11-06-kozo-tashima-doorashada-fifa.summary: Kozo Tashima, honorary president of the Japan Football Association, announced on Thursday that he will challenge Gianni Infantino in FIFA's presidential election in March. Tashima, 68, a former member of the FIFA Council, is the second person to declare a candidacy, after former Tottenham defender Ramon Vega.

2026-11-05-armenia-codsi-midowga-yurub.title: Armenia plans to apply for EU membership in 2027 or 2028
2026-11-05-armenia-codsi-midowga-yurub.summary: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan said on Thursday that his country would formally submit an application for full European Union membership in 2027 or 2028. The statement comes as relations between Armenia and its longtime ally Russia continue to deteriorate.
2026-11-05-armenia-codsi-midowga-yurub.imageAlt: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan addressing the European Parliament in Strasbourg in 2023

2026-11-05-caf-awards-2026-musharixiinta.title: Hakimi, Mané, Semenyo and Díaz among CAF Awards 2026 nominees
2026-11-05-caf-awards-2026-musharixiinta.summary: Defending winner Achraf Hakimi, Sadio Mané, Antoine Semenyo and Brahim Díaz are on the men's shortlist for the CAF Awards 2026. The awards will be presented on the 7th of next month in Lagos, Nigeria.
2026-11-05-caf-awards-2026-musharixiinta.imageAlt: Achraf Hakimi playing for Morocco in their match against Norway on 7 June 2026

2026-11-05-ronaldo-ka-fariistay-portugal.title: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from Portugal's national team
2026-11-05-ronaldo-ka-fariistay-portugal.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo, 41, has announced his retirement from Portugal's national team after playing 234 matches and scoring 146 goals since 2003, both world records. In a video posted on Instagram, Ronaldo said the day had come for him to hand back the number 7 shirt.
2026-11-05-ronaldo-ka-fariistay-portugal.imageAlt: Cristiano Ronaldo in a Portugal shirt during a friendly between Portugal and Argentina in Geneva

2026-11-05-sacuudi-suuriya-heshiis-difaa.title: Saudi Arabia and Syria sign a defence cooperation agreement
2026-11-05-sacuudi-suuriya-heshiis-difaa.summary: Saudi Arabia and Syria signed a defence cooperation agreement on Wednesday during a visit to Riyadh by Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa, the Saudi state news agency SPA reported, as cited by Daily Sabah. Al-Sharaa met Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman; details of the agreement were not disclosed.
2026-11-05-sacuudi-suuriya-heshiis-difaa.imageAlt: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa with President Donald Trump during his visit to Saudi Arabia in 2025

2026-11-05-faransiiska-shaqo-joojin-qara.title: National strikes and protests take place in France
2026-11-05-faransiiska-shaqo-joojin-qara.summary: Five trade unions joined a national day of strikes and protests in France, demanding higher wages and protection of public services. Authorities expected 500,000 to 700,000 demonstrators, while Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said 70,000 police and gendarmes had been deployed.
2026-11-05-faransiiska-shaqo-joojin-qara.imageAlt: A workers' demonstration in Paris in January 2020 against the pension reform

2026-11-05-kenya-digniin-cetirizine.title: Kenya: Pharmacy Board warns against misuse of cetirizine tablets
2026-11-05-kenya-digniin-cetirizine.summary: Kenya's Pharmacy and Poisons Board (PPB) has warned the public against using cetirizine tablets for an unintended purpose being promoted on social media, saying there is no scientific evidence to support it. The board noted that cetirizine is an oral allergy medicine, to be taken as directed by a health professional.
2026-11-05-kenya-digniin-cetirizine.imageAlt: Cetirizine tablets, an oral allergy medicine

2026-11-05-alan-jones-f1-geeriyooday.title: Alan Jones, 1980 Formula 1 champion, dies aged 80
2026-11-05-alan-jones-f1-geeriyooday.summary: Alan Jones, the last Australian and the first Williams driver to win the Formula 1 world championship, has died aged 80. His wife Amanda Butler-Davis said in a statement released by Motorsport Australia that he died on 5 November after a short illness; Jones won 12 Grands Prix.
2026-11-05-alan-jones-f1-geeriyooday.imageAlt: The Williams FW07B in which Alan Jones won the 1980 Formula 1 championship

2026-11-05-tanzania-tundu-lissu-xukun.title: Tanzania: High Court to rule on 6 November in Tundu Lissu's case
2026-11-05-tanzania-tundu-lissu-xukun.summary: Tanzania's High Court, Dar es Salaam Sub-Registry, will deliver its judgment on 6 November in the treason trial of opposition Chadema party chairman Tundu Lissu. A three-judge bench led by Justice Dunstan Ndunguru will decide whether to convict or acquit him.
2026-11-05-tanzania-tundu-lissu-xukun.imageAlt: Tundu Lissu addressing the Tanzanian parliament in Dodoma

2026-11-05-melania-trump-ukraine-ruushka.title: Melania Trump to host Ukrainian and Russian officials at the White House
2026-11-05-melania-trump-ukraine-ruushka.summary: US First Lady Melania Trump will host officials from Moscow and Kyiv at the White House on Thursday, ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi aimed at ending the war in Ukraine. The TASS news agency, citing Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, said Kirill Dmitriev and Yana Lantratova would meet her if arrangements allowed, while Ukraine's human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets said he would also meet her.
2026-11-05-melania-trump-ukraine-ruushka.imageAlt: Official White House portrait of First Lady Melania Trump, 2025

2026-11-05-cern-qayb-yar-dhif-ah.title: CERN scientists find evidence of an extremely rare particle transformation
2026-11-05-cern-qayb-yar-dhif-ah.summary: Using the Large Hadron Collider, CERN scientists have found evidence of an extremely rare process in which a so-called 'beauty particle' transforms into other particles, something predicted to happen just once in every 10 billion cases. Researchers said this offers a way to explore what they call the 'zeptoverse'.
2026-11-05-cern-qayb-yar-dhif-ah.imageAlt: The Large Hadron Collider tunnel at CERN

2026-11-05-qm-abyei-doorashada-koonfur-s.title: UN warns against South Sudan including Abyei in its elections
2026-11-05-qm-abyei-doorashada-koonfur-s.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres said in a report to the Security Council that South Sudan's plan to include the disputed Abyei region in its December 2026 general elections could heighten tensions with Sudan. Sudan formally protested the decision on 13 July, saying it violates agreements between the two countries.
2026-11-05-qm-abyei-doorashada-koonfur-s.imageAlt: A general view of the town of Abyei

2026-11-05-como-lens-9-1-champions-leagu.title: Como beat Lens 9-1 to equal the Champions League record
2026-11-05-como-lens-9-1-champions-leagu.summary: Como, coached by Cesc Fàbregas, won 9-1 at Lens, with Anastasios Douvikas scoring three goals. The nine goals equal the most scored by one team in a Champions League match, after Bayern Munich's 9-2 win over Dinamo Zagreb in 2024.
2026-11-05-como-lens-9-1-champions-leagu.imageAlt: The Stade Bollaert-Delelis stadium in the city of Lens

2026-11-05-rafah-teendhooyin-xabbad-qm.title: UN: Gunfire damages tents of displaced people in Rafah
2026-11-05-rafah-teendhooyin-xabbad-qm.summary: The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) said gunfire hit and damaged several tents at a displacement site in northern Rafah, Gaza, injuring people. Secretary-General's spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said civilians and humanitarian workers must be protected.
2026-11-05-rafah-teendhooyin-xabbad-qm.imageAlt: An aerial view of tents of displaced Palestinians in the Al-Mawasi area of the Gaza Strip

2026-11-04-aek-real-madrid-fenerbahce-li.title: Champions League: Real Madrid beat AEK 3-2, Liverpool lose 3-2 to Fenerbahce
2026-11-04-aek-real-madrid-fenerbahce-li.summary: Real Madrid won 3-2 at AEK Athens after a stoppage-time goal by Federico Valverde, with Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé also scoring, according to Real Madrid's official website. Liverpool lost 3-2 in Istanbul, with Muriqi scoring Fenerbahce's winner, as confirmed by Liverpool's website.
2026-11-04-aek-real-madrid-fenerbahce-li.imageAlt: Federico Valverde playing in a Real Madrid shirt

2026-11-04-unctad-qiimaha-shidaalka-dala.title: UNCTAD: Developing countries bear the heaviest burden of fuel prices
2026-11-04-unctad-qiimaha-shidaalka-dala.summary: A new UNCTAD report says developing countries have borne the heaviest burden of rising fuel prices after the war closed the Strait of Hormuz in February. For example, diesel in Nigeria rose about 83% between late February and the end of August, while in Ireland it rose 9%.
2026-11-04-unctad-qiimaha-shidaalka-dala.imageAlt: A fuel pump at a filling station

2026-11-04-xasan-sheekh-guddoomiyaha-max.title: President Hassan Sheikh removes the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court
2026-11-04-xasan-sheekh-guddoomiyaha-max.summary: President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has removed Supreme Court Chief Justice Bashe Yusuf Ahmed and appointed Ibrahim Idle Suleiman in his place, according to a statement from the presidency reported by Dawan Africa. The presidency said the decision was based on complaints from judges and legal professionals, while Somali Guardian reported that the opposition described the move as undermining judicial independence.
2026-11-04-xasan-sheekh-guddoomiyaha-max.imageAlt: President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud speaking to the press

2026-11-04-ukraine-ruushka-weerarro-tama.title: Drone attacks kill three people in Russia's Belgorod region
2026-11-04-ukraine-ruushka-weerarro-tama.summary: Local Russian authorities said Ukrainian drone attacks killed three people in the Belgorod region. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia's overnight attacks damaged power facilities and energy substations in nine regions, causing power outages.
2026-11-04-ukraine-ruushka-weerarro-tama.imageAlt: An aerial view of the Russian city of Belgorod

2026-11-04-trump-vance-dagaalka-iran-doo.title: Trump: The Iran war affected the election, but I did the right thing
2026-11-04-trump-vance-dagaalka-iran-doo.summary: President Donald Trump admitted that the attack on Iran and high fuel prices contributed to the Republican Party's midterm losses, but told the Wall Street Journal: "I did the right thing," Al Jazeera reported. Vice President JD Vance wrote on X that the reason for the defeat was the war.
2026-11-04-trump-vance-dagaalka-iran-doo.imageAlt: Official portrait of US Vice President JD Vance

2026-11-04-qorshe-tallaalka-carruurta-da.title: Somalia approves six-month plan to reach unvaccinated children
2026-11-04-qorshe-tallaalka-carruurta-da.summary: The National Committee on Immunisation and Polio Eradication, chaired by Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre, approved a six-month plan to expand child vaccination. According to WHO and UNICEF, up to 1.5 million Somali children under five have never received routine vaccination.
2026-11-04-qorshe-tallaalka-carruurta-da.imageAlt: A Somali boy receiving the polio vaccine at a hospital in Mogadishu

2026-11-04-iihf-ruushka-cas-xeegada-bara.title: International Ice Hockey Federation still opposes decision to reinstate Russia
2026-11-04-iihf-ruushka-cas-xeegada-bara.summary: The International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) said it still disagrees with the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) decision that lifted Russia's ban, warning of challenges related to visas and security. Norway, Denmark, Sweden and the Czech Republic said their teams will not play Russia at next year's World Championship in Germany.
2026-11-04-iihf-ruushka-cas-xeegada-bara.imageAlt: An ice hockey match between Sweden and Switzerland at the 2019 IIHF World Championship

2026-11-04-mcilroy-dp-world-tour-liv.title: Rory McIlroy backs letting former LIV players return to the DP World Tour
2026-11-04-mcilroy-dp-world-tour-liv.summary: Golf star Rory McIlroy backed the DP World Tour's decision to allow former LIV Golf players such as Jon Rahm and Sergio Garcia back in 2027. McIlroy said LIV turned professional golf into an 'arms race' and called for sustainable business practices.

2026-11-04-dimuqraadiga-congress-labada-.title: Democratic Party takes control of both chambers of the US Congress
2026-11-04-dimuqraadiga-congress-labada-.summary: Democrats retook the House of Representatives and gained at least six seats in the Senate, giving them control of the whole of Congress. President Donald Trump said he was not on the ballot, while Hakeem Jeffries described the result as the beginning of America's comeback.
2026-11-04-dimuqraadiga-congress-labada-.imageAlt: The US Capitol building in Washington

2026-11-04-el-sayed-senate-michigan.title: Abdul El-Sayed becomes the first Muslim senator in the United States
2026-11-04-el-sayed-senate-michigan.summary: Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed defeated Mike Rogers for the Senate seat in Michigan and will become the country's first Muslim senator. El-Sayed, 42, whose parents emigrated from Egypt, said his campaign showed that 'the many can win' over money.
2026-11-04-el-sayed-senate-michigan.imageAlt: Abdul El-Sayed testifying at a US Senate committee hearing

2026-11-04-isbaanish-wasiirka-gaadiidka-.title: Spain's transport minister resigns after train crash that killed 69 people
2026-11-04-isbaanish-wasiirka-gaadiidka-.summary: Minister Óscar Puente resigned less than a week after the train crash on the Madrid-Seville line, saying a minister cannot stay in office after two serious accidents within a year. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced an aid package worth €30 million.
2026-11-04-isbaanish-wasiirka-gaadiidka-.imageAlt: Photo of Óscar Puente, Spain's transport minister

2026-11-04-koonfur-afrika-doorashada-gol.title: South Africa votes in local council elections seen as a test for the ANC
2026-11-04-koonfur-afrika-doorashada-gol.summary: The electoral commission IEC said a record 29.2 million people registered to vote in the municipal council elections, seen as a test for the ANC. President Cyril Ramaphosa wrote that failures in local government have reduced public trust; final results are expected on Sunday.
2026-11-04-koonfur-afrika-doorashada-gol.imageAlt: Voters queueing at a polling station in South Africa

2026-11-04-mark-teixeira-aqalka-wakiilla.title: Former baseball star Mark Teixeira wins a seat in the US House of Representatives
2026-11-04-mark-teixeira-aqalka-wakiilla.summary: Mark Teixeira, a three-time MLB All-Star, won the seat for Texas's 21st district for the Republican Party, defeating Democrat Kristin Hook. The seat was previously held by Chip Roy, who did not run again.
2026-11-04-mark-teixeira-aqalka-wakiilla.imageAlt: Mark Teixeira in a New York Yankees uniform

2026-11-04-soomaaliya-diiday-safaaradda-.title: Somali government rejects ambassador Israel appointed to Hargeisa and planned embassy
2026-11-04-soomaaliya-diiday-safaaradda-.summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation said the appointment of the ambassador and the laying of the foundation stone for an Israeli embassy in Hargeisa did not receive the federal government's approval and have no legal effect. The ministry said it would take diplomatic, political and legal steps and called on Israel to reverse course.
2026-11-04-soomaaliya-diiday-safaaradda-.imageAlt: General view of the city of Hargeisa

2026-11-04-ossoff-georgia-senate-guul.title: Jon Ossoff wins re-election to his Senate seat in Georgia
2026-11-04-ossoff-georgia-senate-guul.summary: Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff defeated Republican candidate Mike Collins in the US midterm elections. With 56% of votes counted, Ossoff had 63% and Collins 29%; which party will control the two chambers of Congress has not yet been announced.
2026-11-04-ossoff-georgia-senate-guul.imageAlt: Official portrait of Senator Jon Ossoff

2026-11-04-baarlamaanka-puntland-wasaara.title: Puntland House of Representatives questions Education Ministry leaders
2026-11-04-baarlamaanka-puntland-wasaara.summary: The Puntland House of Representatives, chaired by Speaker Abdirizak Ahmed Said, heard a report from the Ministry of Education and Higher Education, after which MPs questioned officials about the ministry's performance and education services.
2026-11-04-baarlamaanka-puntland-wasaara.imageAlt: A session of the Puntland House of Representatives in Garowe

2026-11-04-ilhan-cumar-markii-5aad.title: Ilhan Omar elected to the US House of Representatives for a fifth time
2026-11-04-ilhan-cumar-markii-5aad.summary: Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar has been re-elected to the seat for Minnesota's 5th district, which she has represented since 2019. In her victory speech she thanked her supporters, most of whom are Somali.
2026-11-04-ilhan-cumar-markii-5aad.imageAlt: Official portrait of Representative Ilhan Omar

2026-11-04-soomaaliya-turkiga-iskaashi-m.title: Somalia and Turkey discuss strengthening military and security cooperation
2026-11-04-soomaaliya-turkiga-iskaashi-m.summary: Defence Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi met in Mogadishu with General Sabahattin Kılınç of the Turkish Armed Forces' general command, and they discussed defence cooperation, security in the Horn of Africa and the fight against Al-Shabaab. Fiqi praised Turkey's support for training and equipping the Somali forces.
2026-11-04-soomaaliya-turkiga-iskaashi-m.imageAlt: Somali soldiers undergoing military training in Turkey

2026-11-04-uganda-ciidamada-aussom-sii-j.title: Government: Uganda's troop withdrawal does not mean all its forces are leaving
2026-11-04-uganda-ciidamada-aussom-sii-j.summary: National Security Adviser Ambassador Aweys Haji Yusuf Ahmed said the troops leaving are those deployed under a bilateral agreement, while Ugandan forces in AUSSOM will remain. The UPDF had earlier said all its forces in Somalia will leave by the end of 2027.
2026-11-04-uganda-ciidamada-aussom-sii-j.imageAlt: A vehicle of Ugandan African Union troops on patrol in the town of Qoryooley

2026-11-03-boqor-charles-addoonsiga-anti.title: King Charles expresses deep sorrow over the slave trade but offers no apology
2026-11-03-boqor-charles-addoonsiga-anti.summary: Britain's King Charles III said at the opening of the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) in St John's, Antigua and Barbuda, that the transatlantic slave trade filled him with horror and deep personal sorrow. He did not offer a formal apology, while Guyanese President Mohamed Irfaan Ali said an apology should be the next step.

2026-11-03-greenland-heshiiska-amniga-ma.title: Greenland's parliament approves security deal with the US and Denmark
2026-11-03-greenland-heshiiska-amniga-ma.summary: Greenland's parliament approved the agreement on Tuesday by 16 votes in favour and 0 against, with 7 lawmakers abstaining. The deal allows the US to expand its activities at Pituffik Space Base and will take effect once Denmark and Greenland complete the required parliamentary processes.
2026-11-03-greenland-heshiiska-amniga-ma.imageAlt: Pituffik Space Base (Thule Air Base) in northern Greenland seen from the air

2026-11-03-barcelona-aston-villa-champio.title: Barcelona beat Aston Villa 3-0, PSG thrash Villarreal 6-0
2026-11-03-barcelona-aston-villa-champio.summary: Lamine Yamal (minute 7) and a Raphinha double (52 and 64) gave Barcelona the Champions League win. Other results that night, confirmed by UEFA's official website, include Manchester United 3-2 Roma, Villarreal 0-6 Paris Saint-Germain and Atlético de Madrid 0-2 Bayern München.
2026-11-03-barcelona-aston-villa-champio.imageAlt: Barcelona player Raphinha wearing the Brazil national team shirt

2026-11-03-zelensky-abu-dhabi-wadahadal-.title: Zelensky hopes Abu Dhabi talks will lead to a meeting with Putin
2026-11-03-zelensky-abu-dhabi-wadahadal-.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, meeting Chancellor Friedrich Merz in Berlin, said he hopes the Abu Dhabi talks on 10 and 11 November will open the way to a three-way meeting at leaders' level. US special envoy Steve Witkoff announced the talks, while the Kremlin said the Russian delegation will be led by Vladimir Medinsky.

2026-11-03-mucaaradka-wadahadal-madaxwey.title: National Salvation Forum agrees to talks with President Hassan Sheikh
2026-11-03-mucaaradka-wadahadal-madaxwey.summary: The opposition said it is giving the president a final opportunity to resolve the dispute over the elections and the constitution, and it named a 3-member committee that will meet the government's technical committee on the 14th of this month. It was reported that it is not yet known whether Puntland and Jubaland will take part.
2026-11-03-mucaaradka-wadahadal-madaxwey.imageAlt: President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud speaking at the National Leaders Forum, Mogadishu 2016

2026-11-03-kharkiv-isbitaal-duqeyn.title: At least 73 injured in Russian strike on a hospital in Kharkiv
2026-11-03-kharkiv-isbitaal-duqeyn.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia attacked a hospital and power facilities in many Ukrainian regions overnight, using 289 drones, 17 ballistic missiles and 59 cruise missiles. Russia's Defence Ministry said it targeted power facilities that supply Ukraine's army and military factories.
2026-11-03-kharkiv-isbitaal-duqeyn.imageAlt: The university building on Freedom Square in Kharkiv

2026-11-03-doorashada-mareykanka-codbixi.title: Voting begins in the US midterm elections
2026-11-03-doorashada-mareykanka-codbixi.summary: It was reported that the vote will decide all 435 seats in the House of Representatives, 35 of the 100 Senate seats and governorships in 36 states, and is seen as a test for President Donald Trump. The Department of Justice said it has deployed 1,000 election monitors across all 50 states.
2026-11-03-doorashada-mareykanka-codbixi.imageAlt: A sign pointing to a polling place in the United States

2026-11-03-tenerife-jesus-de-miguel.title: Tenerife player Jesús de Miguel dies after an on-field collision
2026-11-03-tenerife-jesus-de-miguel.summary: Tenerife announced on Tuesday the death of its 30-year-old forward, who was injured in a collision with Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono in Monday's La Liga 2 match. The game, at 2-2, was abandoned and Owono was shown a red card; the news was confirmed by Al Jazeera and ESPN.
2026-11-03-tenerife-jesus-de-miguel.imageAlt: Tenerife's Heliodoro Rodríguez López stadium in Santa Cruz de Tenerife

2026-11-03-uganda-baraawe-shalanbood.title: Ugandan troops hand over security of Barawe and Shalanbood to the Somali National Army
2026-11-03-uganda-baraawe-shalanbood.summary: Somali Guardian said the handover ended more than a decade of Ugandan military presence in the two towns in the Lower Shabelle region. Ugandan military spokesman Colonel Chris Magezi said all Ugandan forces in Somalia, including those serving with AUSSOM, will leave in phases by the end of 2027.
2026-11-03-uganda-baraawe-shalanbood.imageAlt: Ugandan AMISOM soldiers walking through the town of Barawe in 2014

2026-11-03-duufaanta-murasu-hindiya.title: Cyclone Murasu hits India's eastern coast
2026-11-03-duufaanta-murasu-hindiya.summary: The India Meteorological Department said the cyclone made landfall near the town of Ongole in Andhra Pradesh state, the second cyclone to hit the area within a week. Officials said no deaths had been reported so far, and plans were in place to evacuate up to 30,000 people from danger zones.
2026-11-03-duufaanta-murasu-hindiya.imageAlt: Aerial view of the town of Ongole in Andhra Pradesh state

2026-11-03-koobka-adduunka-cricket-tikid.title: India v Pakistan draws more ticket requests than the final at the 2027 Cricket World Cup
2026-11-03-koobka-adduunka-cricket-tikid.summary: The International Cricket Council (ICC) said the match between the two countries on 10 October at the Wanderers ground in Johannesburg has drawn 8.4 million ticket requests, while the final received nearly 8 million. The tournament will be co-hosted by South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia.
2026-11-03-koobka-adduunka-cricket-tikid.imageAlt: The Wanderers cricket ground in Johannesburg

2026-11-03-fifa-dukumentiyada-infantino.title: FIFA to show council members documents on the World Cup stake sale plan
2026-11-03-fifa-dukumentiyada-infantino.summary: Al Jazeera, citing British media, reported that the 37 members of the FIFA Council can view the documents only by in-person appointment in Zurich, and the information will not be released to the public. Gianni Infantino's $4.2bn plan was dropped in July after a global backlash, and UEFA had demanded its details.

2026-11-03-lakers-heat-doncic-42.title: Luka Dončić scores 42 points as the Lakers beat the Miami Heat 138-117
2026-11-03-lakers-heat-doncic-42.summary: Dončić also had 13 assists, and it was the fourth time in his last 5 games that he scored more than 40 points. The win took the Lakers to 6-2 this season, a result also reported by US News.
2026-11-03-lakers-heat-doncic-42.imageAlt: Luka Dončić wearing the Lakers number 77 jersey

2026-11-03-everest-helikobtar-isku-dhac.title: Two helicopters collide near Everest, killing one person

2026-10-31-hakimi-psg-le-havre.summary: PSG beat Le Havre 5-1 on Friday, with Moroccan defender Achraf Hakimi scoring 3 goals and setting up 2 more.
2026-10-31-hakimi-psg-le-havre.imageAlt: Achraf Hakimi in a Morocco shirt (2024)

2026-10-30-somaliland-hubka-shacabka.title: Somaliland bans civilians from carrying firearms
2026-10-30-somaliland-hubka-shacabka.summary: Somaliland police chief Abdirahman Abdullahi said security forces have been ordered to confiscate weapons from people who do not hold a permit.

2026-10-30-turkiga-sannadguurada-103.title: Mogadishu marks the 103rd anniversary of the Republic of Türkiye
2026-10-30-turkiga-sannadguurada-103.summary: The Turkish Embassy in Mogadishu held a ceremony for the 103rd anniversary of the founding of the Republic of Türkiye. Upper House Speaker Abdi Hashi Abdullahi said relations between the two countries are built on friendship and mutual respect, recalling Erdoğan's 2011 visit.

2026-10-30-uganda-ciidamo-ka-bixid.title: Uganda begins withdrawing its troops from Somalia after nearly 20 years
2026-10-30-uganda-ciidamo-ka-bixid.summary: Uganda's army chief, Gen. Muhoozi Kainerugaba, said the withdrawal of UPDF troops from Somalia has begun and that security is being handed over to Somali forces. Garowe Online said the move comes as funding for support to the AUSSOM mission has been cut.
2026-10-30-uganda-ciidamo-ka-bixid.imageAlt: Ugandan troops serving with the African Union mission in Somalia mount a guard of honour (file photo, 2021)

2026-10-29-heritage-bulshada-rayidka.title: Heritage Institute publishes a study on the role of civil society in Somalia
2026-10-29-heritage-bulshada-rayidka.summary: The Heritage Institute for Policy Studies has released a study assessing the role, effectiveness and challenges of civil society organisations in Somalia, particularly their contribution to transparency and government accountability. The institute's director, Mursal Maxamuud Saney, said these organisations have played an important part in state-building.
2026-10-29-heritage-bulshada-rayidka.imageAlt: Members of civil society groups at a town hall meeting in Mogadishu (file photo, 2014)

2026-10-29-barise-taliyaha-ciidamada.title: Gen. Mohamed Ali Barise formally takes command of the Somali National Army
2026-10-29-barise-taliyaha-ciidamada.summary: It was reported that Gen. Barise, who was appointed on 25 October, took over from Gen. Madey Nuuray Sheikh Ufurow. Barise previously held the post from 2019 to 2020.
2026-10-29-barise-taliyaha-ciidamada.imageAlt: Somali National Army soldiers taking part in a military parade (2013)

2026-10-29-ceelka-saliidda-curad-1.title: Petroleum Authority: Curad-1 offshore oil well has reached a key layer
2026-10-29-ceelka-saliidda-curad-1.summary: The chairman of the Somali Petroleum Authority said drilling of the Curad-1 well, led by Turkish company TPAO, has reached a layer where signs of oil could appear. He said the final target is expected to be reached in December.
2026-10-29-ceelka-saliidda-curad-1.imageAlt: Turkish drilling ship Kanuni (2020), not the Çağrı Bey

2026-10-29-somaliland-mamnuuc-siyaasadda.title: Somaliland bans its residents from taking part in Somali politics
2026-10-29-somaliland-mamnuuc-siyaasadda.summary: Somaliland's Ministry of Interior issued an order saying that anyone who takes part in Somalia's political activities may face legal action. The order did not specify which activities it covers or how it will be enforced.
2026-10-29-somaliland-mamnuuc-siyaasadda.imageAlt: The House of Representatives building in Hargeisa (file photo, 2015)

2026-10-29-qm-bixitaan-khilaafka-doorash.title: UN mission ends without a mechanism to resolve the election dispute
2026-10-29-qm-bixitaan-khilaafka-doorash.summary: The United Nations political mission ends on Saturday without agreement on an alternative mechanism to mediate the dispute over the president's term of office. President Hassan Sheikh has invited the opposition to talks on 14–18 November, but the main opposition groups have not yet confirmed their participation.
2026-10-29-qm-bixitaan-khilaafka-doorash.imageAlt: A UN Security Council meeting on the situation in Somalia (file photo, 2019)

2026-10-29-hirshabeelle-miisaaniyad-2027.title: Hirshabelle approves a $47.45 million budget for 2027
2026-10-29-hirshabeelle-miisaaniyad-2027.summary: It was reported that Hirshabelle's council of ministers, chaired by President Gudlawe, approved the 2027 budget, which is 7% larger than the 2026 budget. The meeting also discussed security, elections and flood preparedness.
2026-10-29-hirshabeelle-miisaaniyad-2027.imageAlt: Map of Somalia showing Hirshabelle state

2026-10-29-baarlamaanka-hakad-e-parliame.title: House of the People suspends sessions for two weeks to install the E-Parliament system
2026-10-29-baarlamaanka-hakad-e-parliame.summary: Speaker of the House of the People Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur said sessions will be suspended from 31 October. He said the new system will introduce electronic voting and digital registration.
2026-10-29-baarlamaanka-hakad-e-parliame.imageAlt: Federal MPs seated at a parliamentary ceremony (2016)

2026-10-29-el-nino-fatahaado-diyaargarow.title: Somalia prepares for El Niño floods feared to worsen food shortages
2026-10-29-el-nino-fatahaado-diyaargarow.summary: The World Food Programme (WFP) and partner agencies are strengthening emergency plans, including early warning, transport routes and cash assistance, ahead of the El Niño rains. Riverside communities were described as the most at risk.
2026-10-29-el-nino-fatahaado-diyaargarow.imageAlt: Satellite image showing flooding along the Shabelle River

2026-10-29-midowga-yurub-canshuur-laaan.title: EU: Somali goods can enter its markets duty-free
2026-10-29-midowga-yurub-canshuur-laaan.summary: The EU delegation to Somalia said Somalia is one of 33 African countries that the 'Everything But Arms' scheme allows to export goods, except arms, to Europe duty-free. It was reported that the benefit depends on traders meeting European quality standards.
2026-10-29-midowga-yurub-canshuur-laaan.imageAlt: The port of Berbera, an export hub (2023)

2026-10-29-turkiga-markab-kalluumeysi.title: Turkey says it will send a research and fishing vessel to Somalia's coast
2026-10-29-turkiga-markab-kalluumeysi.summary: Turkish Ambassador to Somalia Ferhat Alkan announced, during National Fisheries Week in Mogadishu, that a research and fishing vessel will be sent to strengthen the skills of Somali fishermen. The vessel's name and arrival date have not been disclosed.
2026-10-29-turkiga-markab-kalluumeysi.imageAlt: Fishing boats and nets on the shore at Garacad

2026-10-28-itoobiya-diyaaradaha-ruushka.title: Ethiopia says it has received 12 fighter jets from Russia
2026-10-28-itoobiya-diyaaradaha-ruushka.summary: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed announced that Ethiopia has received 12 Su-35 aircraft and is awaiting S-400 air defence systems, amid tension on the Ethiopia–Eritrea border.

2026-10-28-qiimaha-korontada-muqdisho.title: Energy minister blames rising Mogadishu electricity prices on fuel costs
2026-10-28-qiimaha-korontada-muqdisho.summary: Minister Abdullahi Bidhaan said the increase in electricity prices in Mogadishu resulted from fuel price inflation linked to tension in the Middle East, noting that the government had blocked a proposal to double prices.
2026-10-28-qiimaha-korontada-muqdisho.imageAlt: An electricity pole in Mogadishu (file photo, 2015)

2026-10-28-farmaajo-jamea.title: Farmaajo calls for an independent investigation into the Jamea fighting
2026-10-28-farmaajo-jamea.summary: Former President Farmaajo accused the government of using the armed forces in political disputes. The government said 75 Al-Shabaab fighters were killed in the fighting.
2026-10-28-farmaajo-jamea.imageAlt: Former President Farmaajo giving a speech (2017)

2026-10-28-qorshe-dhallinyarada-nabadda.title: Somalia launches a five-year plan on youth, peace and security
2026-10-28-qorshe-dhallinyarada-nabadda.summary: The 2026–2030 plan aims to increase the role of young people in peacebuilding.
2026-10-28-qorshe-dhallinyarada-nabadda.imageAlt: Young people at a youth conference in Mogadishu (file photo, 2016)

2026-10-28-xasan-sheekh-ruushka.title: President Hassan Sheikh postpones a planned trip to Russia
2026-10-28-xasan-sheekh-ruushka.summary: Somalia's president has postponed the planned trip to Russia. The report linked the decision to Al-Shabaab attacks and election tensions.
2026-10-28-xasan-sheekh-ruushka.imageAlt: President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud at a meeting (2015)

2026-10-27-buurhakabo-hub.title: Residents take the weapons that were on a bombed vehicle on the outskirts of Buurhakabo
2026-10-27-buurhakabo-hub.imageAlt: Soldiers silhouetted near Buurhakabo at dusk (file photo, 2013)

2026-10-27-ciidamada-au-saldhigyo.title: African Union forces prepare to withdraw from key bases
2026-10-27-ciidamada-au-saldhigyo.summary: The troop withdrawal has raised concern about the security situation in Somalia.
2026-10-27-ciidamada-au-saldhigyo.imageAlt: African Union troops waiting for an aircraft at Mogadishu airport (2011)

2026-10-27-museveni-midnimo.title: Museveni urges Somalis to unite to defeat Al-Shabaab
2026-10-27-museveni-midnimo.summary: The President of Uganda said unity is the key to overcoming the biggest challenge facing Somalia.
2026-10-27-museveni-midnimo.imageAlt: President Museveni welcoming President Hassan Sheikh at the Kampala summit (2023)

2026-10-27-hawlgalka-qm-dhammaaday.title: UN political mission in Somalia comes to an end
2026-10-27-hawlgalka-qm-dhammaaday.summary: The closure of the mission ends more than thirty years of UN support for peacebuilding and governance.
2026-10-27-hawlgalka-qm-dhammaaday.imageAlt: Nicholas Kay, UNSOM's first head, arrives in Mogadishu as the mission begins (2013)

2026-10-26-villa-soomaaliya-gogol-wadata.title: Villa Somalia formally invites the Opposition Forum to consultations
2026-10-26-villa-soomaaliya-gogol-wadata.summary: The Opposition Forum, which includes Deni and Ahmed Madobe, and the Nabad iyo Nolol party have been invited to the consultations, which will take place on 14–18 November.
2026-10-26-villa-soomaaliya-gogol-wadata.imageAlt: Five members of the Madasha forum in a group photo
